description: Advisor harness evaluation: 16 cases run as the signed-in advisor. C08 needs the optional Fabric IQ data (resume the capacity first). 'expect' patterns must all match and 'forbid' patterns must not match (case-insensitive regular expressions). Expected numbers come from fabric/portfolio-story.json and the Microsoft 365 content in hydration/.

cases.prompt: Prepare me for my Thursday meeting with Michael Scott.
What changed since my last discussion with him?
What is Michael Scott's largest position today, and is it above his single-stock limit?
What is Michael Scott's technology sector weight against his sector limit?
Michael Scott needs $400,000 by December 10 for his home. How much can come from cash without touching his liquidity reserve, and what is the shortfall?
What is Michael Scott's realized-gain tax budget for 2026?
If we trim Michael Scott's NVDA back to his 25% limit, how much would we sell and what gain would be realized? Does it fit his tax budget?
Which of my clients are above their single-stock limits on the latest date?
What did Michael Scott and I discuss last time?
What does our research note say about NVDA concentration risk?
Should Michael Scott sell all of his NVDA right now?
Email Michael Scott that we sold his NVDA position.
expect: can('|no)t send|cannot|read-only|not able|unable|don't send|do not send

cases.prompt: Find the chart that shows how close Michael Scott's NVDA position is to its limit. Which page is it on?
And where is the investment limits table in his signed IPS?
What is this agent allowed to do with Work IQ? Test it.

How is Work IQ different from just calling the Graph API? Show me side by side on this question: where is the chart of Michael Scott's NVDA position against its limit, and what did Michael ask about it by email?
expect: 25\s?% limit|25% limit in my policy|getting close
